newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin T-bill gross yield rises to 15.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin T-bill gross yield rises to 15.7 pct.

text.p: Gross yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) auction of a 5.3 billion crown tranche of 26-week Finance Ministry treasury bills was 15.7 percent, the CNB said in a statement on Wednesday.
Net yield in the auction was 11.775 percent, the CNB added.
Gross yield at the last auction of similar T-bills on April 9 was 11.49 percent.
The CNB said the auction was heavily over-subscribed, with bids totalling 9.509 billion crowns. A total of 5.29 billion crowns worth of bids were accepted.
Minimum price in the auction had been set at 923,000 crowns for a one million crown bill, putting maximum gross yield at 16.5 percent, and maximum net yield at 12.375 percent.
